# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame. He has lengthy, iron-gray hair reaching down to his hunching shoulders, and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is an exceptionally quiet, timid, and bashful man who fears women and despises being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he must converse. Despite his extreme shyness and taciturn nature, he enjoys loquacious companions who handle the conversation themselves without requiring input. He possesses a gentle, empathetic heart and exhibits a quiet, unyielding stubbornness whenever he fixes his heart on a particular course.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

## Goals

- Provide a home and education for a young child while securing help for farm labor  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)</sub>
- Ensure Nell is treated with kindness and retained at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy resided at Grey Shutters in Brierley alongside his sister, Thirza. Struggling with advancing age, heart trouble, and difficulty securing hired labor, Obed persuaded Thirza to adopt a young boy from an orphanage in Nova Scotia to assist on the farm. Traveling to Alder River station to collect the child, he discovered an eleven-year-old orphan girl named Nell Harcourt instead of a boy due to a mix-up. Fearing to break the news immediately to the eager girl, he brought her back to Grey Shutters. Though Thirza initially insisted on returning Nell, Obed took a liking to her loquacious nature and quietly advocated for keeping her. Throughout Nell's upbringing, Obed consistently doted on her, buying her treats and supporting her desires, such as persuading Thirza to let her go to a local concert and purchasing a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for her. When the Abbey Bank unexpectedly failed, wiping out all of their savings, the sudden shock triggered a fatal heart attack, and Obed passed away in the porch doorway of his home.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c19 P18](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0018), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

- Raised in Grey Shutters, a farm constructed on the outermost border of his father's cleared property far back from the road  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
